title: Ontario Online Casino Handle Jumps to 89% as Sports Betting Slows
excerpt: New provincial data shows Ontario’s online casino handle surging while sports betting volumes soften.
author: Lisa Davids
bodyHtml:
Fresh market data reveals that Ontario’s online casino handle leapt to 89% of total wagering while sports betting cooled over the same period, underlining how casino play anchors the regulated market.

The figures reflect a maturing Ontario market where slots and live dealer games generate consistent volume year-round, smoothing the seasonal swings that affect sports betting.
